El Cerrito Finance
A sourced record of El Cerrito’s financial condition, drawn directly from primary source documents: S&P Global Ratings publications, the City’s audited annual financial reports (CAFRs/ACFRs), the California State Auditor, and the City’s own financial records.
Pages

* [Budget vs. Actual](budget-actual.html) — General Fund revenue vs. expenditure, original budget vs. actual, and the FY2025-26 Fourth Quarter Update
* [Credit Rating History](credit-rating.html) — S&P’s underlying rating (SPUR) on the City’s certificates of participation, 2013–present
* [Going-Concern Audits](going-concern.html) — Every fiscal year the City’s audited financial statements carried a going-concern designation, 2012–2025
* [State Auditor Report](state-auditor.html) — Findings from California State Auditor Report 2020-803
* [TRAN Borrowing](tran.html) — Annual short-term borrowing, FY2012–FY2022
* [Tax Collections](tax-collections.html) — Real Property Transfer Tax and other tax revenue
* [RDA Dissolution](rda-dissolution.html) — What the 2011–2012 state dissolution of redevelopment agencies cost El Cerrito

Each page reports documented facts without attributing responsibility to any individual.
